list_icons.title: Device Icon
list_icons.custom_device_icon: If you wish to use a custom icon for your device, you can upload it here. The icon needs to be in .svg format.
list_icons.select_device_icon: Or select one from the list.
list_icons.set_icon_and_customize: Here you can select an icon (id) for your device. You can change the icon for each ID/number later through App Settings, but you cannot change which icon ID your device uses after creation. So pick a Unique icon/number for each device. Any icon can be chosen for devices and capabilities, the categories are for clarity.  All icons can be set to any default icon through App Settings.
